name: Calibration Shell Trial
author: GuildBuild
summary: Ten harder terminal and code tasks: two bugs behind one failure, migration order, commit hygiene, honest handoff when tests cannot run, a secret already in history, a diff review, scope creep, a cost-aware lookup, a quoted-CSV count, and a flaky suite. Written by the guild so every build on the same model compares across categories.
notes: v1.1.0 replaces the v1.0 slice, which Sonnet 5.5 passed at 94 to 100 percent with no build separating from the bare runtime. Each new case has a known-answer check or a process check a careless run fails: a second bug behind the first, a dependency that cannot be installed, a secret already in history, a reformat the contributing rules forbid, a huge log that must not be read. Deterministic graders only; a run costs under a dollar. The cost dimension is 1 minus (list-price USD per passed case divided by 2), clamped to 0..1.

changelog.note: Ten new cases that discriminate; the v1.0 cases are retired. Records on earlier versions no longer count toward tiers.

Grader patterns carried doubled backslashes from the authoring script, so every grader with a backslash (tool-input matches, file regexes, the CSV row count) could never pass. Patterns corrected; v1.0.0 records are superseded.
